tasks.label: Configure CMake Debug
tasks.command: set -a && source local.agora.env && set +a && cmake -S . -B build-debug -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug

tasks.label: Build mac_real_adapter_test Debug
tasks.command: set -a && source local.agora.env && set +a && cmake -S . -B build-debug -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build-debug --target mac_real_adapter_test
